escalations.question: T1 C2 says the fix 'keeps the Pod bar at the width it has without an alert, so each Pod tab title keeps its width'. Under flex: 1 1 0 the title widths are kept but the pod-bar element's own width is not (both flex items grow into leftover space). Which clause is the requirement?
escalations.answer: The title-width clause is the requirement; amend C2's wording to match (A1). T1 is committed as it stands.

options.summary: The title-width clause is the requirement; amend C2's wording to match
options.rationale: O17, the scored evidence C2 cites, passes on title widths and only records the pod-bar width

options.summary: Keep the letter: the pod-bar width must not change (e.g. .dismissible flex: 0 1 0)
options.rationale: The panel absorbs all leftover space, but the alert row shrinks to min-content, about one glyph per line, so the visible message is mostly unreadable
